Preliminary estimates are that in the most heavily affected districts (which includes

Kathmandu), about 2.8 million people are affected. Initial analysis suggests that the

earthquake will push an additional 2.5-3.5 percent of Nepalis (700,000-982,000 people)

into poverty in 2015/16. Further, within the most affected districts, the impacts are

disproportionately felt by the poorest segments of the population. Even within the relatively

prosperous areas that have been affected, households that were already either poor or

vulnerable have been particularly exposed.
